record.name: AI英会話チューター：発音指導で毎日スピーキング上達へ
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
SpeakFloe は、「単語は知っている」から「実際に話せる」へ進むための、AI 搭載スピーキングチューターです。リアルな会話を練習し、その場で修正を受け取り、短い毎日のセッションで英語の流暢さを高めることができます。

レッスンの内容は理解できても、実際の会話になると言葉が止まってしまう。そんな経験があるなら、あなたは一人ではありません。多くの学習者は文法や単語を知っていても、素早く返答し、適切な言葉を選び、会話を自然に続ける場面で苦労します。SpeakFloe はまさにその瞬間のために作られました。受け身の知識を、実際に使えるスピーキング力へと変えていきます。

使い方

• AI チューターに向かって声に出して話し、自然に会話を続けます
• 文法、語句の選び方、文の組み立てについて即時フィードバックを受けられます
• 分かりやすく実践的なアドバイスで発音を改善できます
• より自然で、より丁寧で、より自信のある言い換え表現を学べます

使えるフィードバック

SpeakFloe はただ「間違い」と言うだけではありません。次のことを分かりやすく教えてくれます。
• 自分が何を言ったのか、その意味は何か
• 何をどう直せばよいのか、なぜ直すのか
• より自然なフレーズやよく使われる表現
• 修正後の文を繰り返し、新しい言い方も試せるミニ練習

本物の場面に近い練習

場面を選んで、すぐに話し始められます。
• 旅行と日常生活：注文、道案内、ホテル、雑談
• 学校と試験：面接形式の質問、IELTS / TOEFL のスピーキング練習
• 仕事とビジネス：会議、プレゼン、サポート対応、交渉
• ソーシャル：友達作り、オンライン会話、招待、意見を伝える練習
• 楽しい話題：趣味、映画、スポーツ、テクノロジーなど

自分に合わせた学習

SpeakFloe はあなたに合わせて調整されます。
• 初級から上級まで、自分のレベルを選べます
• もっと簡単な説明や、より難しい質問をいつでもリクエストできます
• 時制、冠詞、前置詞、発音、語彙など、苦手分野を重点的に練習できます
• 役立つフレーズを保存して、あとから復習できます

知識だけでなく、自信も育てる

読む・書くはできても、話すとなると止まってしまう学習者は多くいます。SpeakFloe はあなたが
• 英語でより速く考える
• 間を減らして話す
• より自然で分かりやすく話す
• 新しい場面でも安心して話す
• 安全で評価されない環境で不安を減らす
ためのサポートをします。

続けやすい毎日の習慣

• 授業の合間や仕事のあとでも続けやすい短いセッション
• やさしいリマインダーと目標設定
• 練習時間、連続記録、改善ポイントで進歩を確認
• 無理なく続けられる小さな毎日の一歩

学生、旅行者、社会人に

試験対策、新しい国への移住、キャリアアップなど、どんな目的でも SpeakFloe は安心して英語を話す練習ができる場所を提供します。

練習できること

• 発音：難しい音、アクセント、リズム
• 流暢さ：自然なつなぎ言葉を使ってスムーズに話す
• 語彙：教科書だけではない、実生活で使える言葉
• 文法：終わりのない暗記ではなく、正しい構文を身につける
• スピーキング力：質問に答える、考えを説明する、物語を話す

プライバシー

学習体験を安全でプライベートに保てるよう努めています。何を共有するかはあなたが決め、自分のペースで練習できます。

SpeakFloe で、今日から話し始めましょう。

SpeakFloe で、今日から話し始めましょう。

SpeakFloe is an AI-powered speaking tutor that helps you turn “I know the words” into “I can actually speak.” Practice real conversations, get instant corrections, and build fluency and confidence with short daily sessions. Turn passive knowledge into active speaking ability you can use in everyday life, work, travel, and social situations.

If you have ever understood a lesson but felt stuck in a real conversation or lost confidence, you are not alone. SpeakFloe is built for the moment you need to answer quickly, choose the right words, and keep talking without overthinking. It helps you speak more naturally and respond with confidence in a supportive, judgment-free way.

HOW IT WORKS  
• Speak out loud to your AI tutor and keep the conversation going naturally.  
• Get immediate, clear feedback on grammar, word choice, sentence structure, and fluency.  
• Improve pronunciation, stress, and rhythm with clear, actionable tips you can apply right away.  
• Learn natural alternatives (what sounds more fluent, more polite, or more confident).  
• Repeat corrected sentences and try new variations to make the learning stick.  

SMART FEEDBACK YOU CAN USE  
SpeakFloe does not just say “wrong.” It helps you understand:  
• What you said, and what it means  
• What to change and why (simple explanations)  
• Better options: more natural phrases and common expressions  
• Mini practice: repeat the corrected sentence and try a new variation  
This turns every mistake into a real learning opportunity.

PRACTICE THAT FEELS REAL  
Choose a situation and start talking:  
• Travel and everyday life: ordering food, directions, hotel check-in, shopping, and small talk  
• School and exams: interview-style questions, IELTS/TOEFL speaking practice  
• Work and business: meetings, presentations, support calls, and negotiation  
• Social life: making friends, chatting online, invitations, and opinions  
• Fun topics: hobbies, movies, sports, technology  

PERSONALIZED LEARNING  
SpeakFloe adapts to you:  
• Pick your level (beginner to advanced) and your goals.  
• Ask for simpler explanations, more challenging questions, or a different topic anytime.  
• Practice your weak spots: tenses, articles, prepositions, pronunciation, vocabulary.  
• Save useful phrases and review them later to make them stick.  
• Easily track your progress, streaks, and areas for improvement.  

BUILD CONFIDENCE, NOT JUST KNOWLEDGE  
Many learners can read and write, but freeze when it is time to speak. SpeakFloe is designed to help you:  
• think faster in English  
• speak with fewer pauses  
• sound more natural and clear  
• feel comfortable in new situations  
• reduce anxiety by practicing in a safe, judgment-free space  

DAILY ROUTINE MADE EASY  
• Quick 5–15 minute sessions that fit between classes or after work  
• Gentle reminders and personal goals to keep you consistent  
• A simple way to measure progress: practice minutes, streaks, and improvement areas  
• Learn in small steps, every day, without burnout  

FOR STUDENTS, TRAVELERS, AND PROFESSIONALS  
Whether you are preparing for an exam, moving to a new country, leveling up your career, or simply wanting to express yourself more confidently, SpeakFloe gives you a safe and judgment-free place to practice speaking as much as you want.

WHAT YOU CAN PRACTICE  
• Pronunciation: tricky sounds, stress, rhythm, and natural flow  
• Fluency: speaking smoothly with natural connectors  
• Vocabulary: useful words and expressions for real life, not only textbooks  
• Grammar: correct and natural structures without memorizing endless rules  
• Speaking skills: answering questions, explaining ideas, telling stories, and keeping a conversation going  

PRIVACY  
We aim to keep your learning private and secure. You control what you share, and you can practice at your own pace.

record.name: Seeing AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Seeing AI is a free app that narrates the world around you. Designed with and for the blind and low vision community, this ongoing research project harnesses the power of AI to open up the visual world by describing nearby people, text and objects. 

Seeing AI provides tools to assist with a variety of daily tasks: 
•	Read - Hear text as soon as it appears in front of the camera. Document alignment provides audio cues to capture a printed page and recognize the text along with its original formatting. Ask Seeing AI about the contents to easily find the information you need.
•	Describe - Take photos to hear a rich description. Ask questions to focus on the information you care about. Explore photos by moving your finger over the screen to hear the location of different objects.
•	Products - Scan barcodes and Accessible QR codes using audio beeps to guide you; hear the product name and package information when available.
•	People - Save photos of friends and coworkers so you can recognize them later. Get an estimate of their age, gender, and expression.
•	Currency - Recognize currency notes. 
•	Find My Things - Teach Seeing AI to recognize your personal objects and follow the audio cues to find them later. 
•	World - An Audio Augmented Reality experience to explore an unfamiliar environment, including hearing objects announced around you with Spatial Audio (requires a device with a LiDAR, and iOS 14+). 
•	Colors - Identify colors.
•	Light - Hear an audible tone corresponding to the brightness of your surroundings.
•	Photos and Videos in other apps - Just tap “Share” and “Recognize with Seeing AI” to describe media from Mail, Photos, WhatsApp, and more. 
•	Browse Photos - Hear descriptions of photos and videos saved on your device.

Seeing AI continues to evolve as we hear from the community, and AI research advances.

Visit http://SeeingAI.com for more details.

Questions, feedback or feature requests? Email us at SeeingAI@Microsoft.com.

record.name: Supersense - AI for Blind
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Supersense is the smartest and simplest scanner app made for the blind and visually impaired users to read any text format, currency or product details from a barcode independently.

With the power of AI, Supersense automatically figures out what you are trying to scan, guides you on how to point the camera, and reads the content in the right format. Its unique design minimizes the time and frustrations of scanning and reading text for a blind and visually impaired user.

Full features of Supersense:
- Smart Scanner: The app automatically detects whether you are trying to quickly read a piece of text, a long document, a currency or a barcode.
- Smart Guidance: The app guides you on how to point the camera and finds the best angle to have the most accurate results
-  Quick Read: Instantly read the text presented in front of the rear camera
- Document: Read longer documents with the assistance of smart guidance. Once the text has been recognized, use VoiceOver commands to navigate through the recognized text and share it to other apps.
- Multipage Scanning: Scan documents with multiple pages simultaneously and navigate through the text. 
- Currency: Recognize currencies and hear the value of a banknote
- Barcode: Scan barcodes to hear the name and brand of the products with additional information
- Object Explorer and Find: Scan your physical environment and hear about the objects that are around.
- Import: Read and explore text from the images and PDF files. Also you can send them directly from any other apps with using "Recognize with Supersense" tool in your share menu.
- Read History: Displays your recognition history in a single screen.

Most features work without an internet connection so that the blind or visually impaired user can use it in any situation. The app has full VoiceOver accessibility support and is available in multiple languages. Whenever you get stuck, you can always find our tutorial under Menu or request a call and we will reach you to give personal training on how to use Supersense.

Supersense is developed by Mediate, an MIT-spinoff AI start-up based in Boston. Mediate develops innovative computer vision systems with the support of the National Science Foundation and the US Department of Veterans Affairs. This app is just the first step in our mission to develop groundbreaking AI solutions for people with visual disabilities. We have developed the app with principles of human-centered design and with the assistance of blind and visually impaired users. We also partnered with many organizations that help the blind and low vision community.

If you would like any assistance, please email us at supersense@mediate.tech. We always love to hear ideas and feedback from the blind and visually impaired community.

Subscription Plans:
Supersense has limited access to all features. If you would like unlimited access, we have created subscription plans.

- Monthly Subscription: $4.99
- Yearly Subscription: $49.99
- Lifetime Subscription: $99.99

These subscription plans help us to continuously develop new features to provide immense value to the blind and the visually impaired.

If you choose to purchase a subscription, the payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. All subscription plans automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. If you don't choose to purchase a subscription plan, you can simply continue using designated Supersense features for free.

You can read our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy from here: https://mediate.tech/policies

We hope you will enjoy your new super sense!

record.description_evidence:
Claudia is a calm, private AI assistant for your phone.

She talks like a person. She remembers what you ask her to remember. She runs on the AI providers you already pay for, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and others, with no extra subscription on top.

No accounts. No login. No servers holding your conversations. Your chats live on your device.

What Claudia does

Talk by voice or text. Tap the mic and speak, or type. Claudia replies in a natural voice or on screen, whichever you prefer.

Remembers what matters. Tell Claudia a fact about yourself and she keeps it in on-device memory. She recalls it later, even in a new conversation. Everything lives in a local database on your phone.

Your voice, your choice. Use the built-in iOS voice at no cost, or bring your own ElevenLabs key for premium voice quality.

See it before you connect anything. A built-in demo mode runs a short sample conversation right on your device, so you can feel how Claudia works first.

What makes Claudia different

Bring your own AI key. No monthly Claudia subscription. Use the API key you already have with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, xAI, or OpenRouter. You pay the provider directly for what you use. No middleman markup.

Built for privacy. Your conversations do not pass through a Claudia server, because there is no Claudia server for them to pass through. The app talks directly to the AI provider you choose, and only after you give explicit consent for anything to leave your device.

Your keys stay yours. API keys are stored in the iOS Keychain. They are never sent anywhere except the provider you picked.

Nothing tracked. Our App Store privacy label is Data Not Collected. We do not run ads and we do not sell data, because we never collect it in the first place.

Built by an indie team

Claudia is built by PrentusAI, a small, independent shop. You bring your own AI key, the app stays out of your way, and that is the whole deal.

Privacy policy and full terms at prentusai.com/claudia.

Requires an API key from a supported AI provider. iPhone only.

record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
SightSense is an AI accessibility app built for blind and low-vision users who want more than static descriptions. Unlike apps that focus mainly on identifying what’s in view, SightSense is designed for continuous, real-time spatial understanding through live audio and haptic feedback—helping you sense where things are, how far away they are, and how to orient yourself as you move.

SightSense is fully compatible with built-in iPhone VoiceOver navigation, and the UI is specifically designed for use with VoiceOver.

SightSense recognizes scenes, objects, signs, text, layout, and context, then communicates what’s happening using sounds and haptics. Tailor responses to your preference—from a quick summary to a detailed breakdown—and control everything with simple voice commands or gestures.

Navigation Mode describes what’s around you as you move, identifying key landmarks and giving directional clock-face cues for spatial awareness. Text Mode finds and reads print, labels, QR codes, and barcodes, guiding your aim with vibration and sound cues. You can switch modes by voice, gesture, or using VoiceOver.

Photo and video descriptions let you capture a moment and hear explanations or ask targeted questions about what’s in the frame. Locate Mode, first of its kind, lets you choose what you want to find—like “door,” “chair,” or “laptop”—and SightSense helps you track it down with increasingly strong haptics, audio cues, and panning audio feedback with earbuds, giving an intuitive “sonar-like” perception of location.

Designed with guidance from accessibility organizations and direct feedback from blind and low-vision testers, SightSense supports VoiceOver, adapts to your environment, and includes vibration strength, verbosity, sensitivity, and audio cue controls to match your preferences.

Download SightSense and explore the world through your camera lens!
